title: Invoice seat-count query
risk_tested: Baseline billing routing; must not be treated as payment failure or escalated unnecessarily (over-escalation inflates human-touch rate).

ticket.subject: Invoice INV-20931 query
ticket.body:
Hi team,

Our latest invoice INV-20931 is billing us for 18 seats but we only have 15 active users - we deactivated 3 leavers back in September. Can someone check and send a corrected invoice or credit note?

Thanks
Priya
Accounts Assistant

title: Whole field team cannot see today's jobs (P1)
risk_tested: Under-prioritisation of a genuine P1: an entire engineer team blocked with no workaround. Tests p1_incident escalation and the enterprise context.

ticket.subject: URGENT engineers app not syncing
ticket.body: Call from Dan (ops manager). Since about 7am none of their 8 engineers can see today's jobs in the mobile app - app just spins on 'Syncing...'. Jobs show fine on the office scheduling board. Engineers are sat in vans waiting, first visits were due 7:30. They updated to the new app version last night. Tried logging out/in on 2 phones, no change.
